{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue'] == 999999.99]
print(f'Number of QA orders: {len(qa_orders)}')

# Check for refunded orders — they should be excluded from revenue
refunded_orders = sales[sales['status'] == 'refunded']
print(f'Number of refunded orders: {len(refunded_orders)}')

# Confirm channel values
print(f'Unique channels: {sales["channel"].unique()}')

# Now compute total revenue by channel, excluding refunded orders
# Only completed orders contribute to revenue
total_revenue_by_channel = sales[sales['status'] == 'completed'].groupby('channel')['revenue'].sum()
print(total_revenue_by_channel)"}
